scripts.deploy:preview: node prepare-deploy-config.mjs preview && wrangler deploy --config .wrangler.preview.generated.json --env preview
scripts.deploy:production: node prepare-deploy-config.mjs production && wrangler deploy --config .wrangler.production.generated.json --env production
scripts.migrate:deletion:preview: node prepare-deploy-config.mjs preview && wrangler d1 migrations apply DELETION_DB --remote --config .wrangler.preview.generated.json --env preview
scripts.migrate:deletion:production: node prepare-deploy-config.mjs production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DELETION_DB --remote --config .wrangler.production.generated.json --env production
scripts.migrate:primary:preview: node prepare-deploy-config.mjs preview && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .wrangler.preview.generated.json --env preview
scripts.migrate:primary:production: node prepare-deploy-config.mjs production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .wrangler.production.generated.json --env production
scripts.test: npm run test:worker && npm run test:node
